blocks.text: Definition: Deliverance is setting free, {{jo 8:32|John 8:32}}: Expelling of demons, Breaking of yokes, Is. 10:27; Ez. 34:27. Removing curses. Loosing of bonds {{lk 10:19|Luke 10:19}}.
There are four different types of deliverance mentioned in the Bible:

This study will focus on deliverance from demons; how they come in, how to obtain our deliverance and how to stay delivered God said that our bodies are the temple of the Holy Spirit ({{1co 6:19,1co 6:20|I Cor. 6:19,20}}) but the devil's desire is to seek to invade the body of man. The Triune man (spirit, soul and body) must be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

cards.heading: A. How demons gain access to man

blocks.text: Demons cannot just decide to possess or oppress a man without cause {{prv 26:2|Prov. 26:2}}; Covenants, curses and sins give demons legal authority over the life of a person or nation.

1. Covenant: This is an agreement between two or more parties. It could be holy or demonic. Any violation will always attract some form of penalty. Types of covenants include: blood covenant {{gn 17:10|Gen. 17:10}}; {{1co 11:25|I cor. 11:25}}, peace covenants {{js 9:14,js 9:15|Josh. 9:14-15}} marriage covenants {{ml 2:14|Mal. 2:14}}, oaths covenant {{gn 31:48,gn 31:49,gn 31:50,gn 31:51,gn 31:52,gn 31:53|Gen. 31:48-53}} 2. Curses: This is often the result of violating the articles of a covenant or the result of sins against God's laws. {{gn 3:14,gn 3:15,gn 3:16,gn 3:17,gn 3:18,gn 3:19|Gen. 3:14-19}}; {{js 6:26|Josh. 6:26}}; {{2sm 21:1,2sm 21:2|II Sam. 21:1-2}}; {{ml 1:12,ml 1:13,ml 1:14|Mal. 1:12-14}}; 2:1-2; 3:8- 10; {{gn 35:16,gn 35:17,gn 35:18,gn 35:19|Gen. 35:16-19}}

items: Sin: There are three major doorways of sin that give Satan the authority to cause havoc in the lives of people.

Everybody under demonic influence needs deliverance. The activity of demons could manifest in several ways. Family-line tragedies, repeated or regular tragedy, sexual immorality, stagnancy in life, rejection, unwarranted miscarriages, abnormal dreams, abnormal development of one or more of the senses, emotional imbalance (resentment, envy, jealousy, hatred, depression, procrastination poor memory, etc. ) addiction (certain food, sex, etc ), speech perversion ( lying, exaggeration, back-bitting, etc), certain physical disorders, consultation of the psychics, witchcraft, occultism and religious perversion, knighthood.

items: Methods of deliverance {{act 3:6|Acts. 3:6}}, {{1pe 1:18,1pe 1:19|I Pet 1: 18-19}}; {{hb 2:14|Heb 2: 14}}; {{mk 9:29|Mark 9: 29}}; {{lk 4:40,lk 4:41|Luke 4: 40-41}}; {{1sm 16:23|I Sam. 16: 23}}, Praising God, using the Word of God, anointing with oil, using the name of Jesus, sometimes fasting, speaking in tongues, etc. Note that it is important to let the Holy Spirit Guide you when ministering deliverance.

blocks.text: Be born again {{jo 3:3,jo 3:4,jo 3:5|Jn 3: 3-5}}; forgive others {{mk 11:25,mk 11:26|Mk 11: 25-26}}, repent {{lk 13:3|Lk 13: 3}}; do not hold on to occult symbols/objects/Talismans etc; renounce every agreement/commitment/relationship or Trust on these. Confess your deliverance with your mouth in the name of Jesus Christ {{gl 3:13|Gal 3: 13}}; 5: 1; {{mt 12:43,mt 12:44,mt 12:45|Matt 12: 43-45}}; {{jo 5:14|Jn 5: 14}}; {{2tm 2:15|II Tim 2: 15}}; {{js 1:8|Josh 1: 8}}; {{1pe 1:13,1pe 1:14,1pe 1:15|I Pet 1: 13-15}}; {{dt 18:9,dt 18:10|Deut 18: 9-10}}; {{re 12:11|Rev 12: 11}}; {{1jo 4:18|I Jn 4: 18}}; {{cl 3:16|Col 3: 16}}; {{act 1:8|Acts 1: 8}}; {{1co 14:15|I Cor 14: 15}}; {{hb 10:25|Heb 10: 25}}; {{mt 28:10,mt 28:11,mt 28:12,mt 28:13,mt 28:14,mt 28:15,mt 28:16,mt 28:17,mt 28:18,mt 28:19,mt 28:20|Matt 28: 10-20}}Live a holy life, avoid all old habits, keep off from occultic practices, confess your deliverance always, study the Bible always, pray all the time, fellowship with Christians, preach the gospel of Jesus Christ to everyone, testifying of God's goodness to you to anyone who listens to you.

conclusion.text: This study is not exhaustive in any way concerning this subject. Nevertheless, whatever the affliction you are going through, today is the day of your deliverance! Let it be so in Jesus name. Amen
